title: Libya: UN mission urges probe into Benghazi port attacks
summary: The UN Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL) has called for an independent investigation into attacks carried out at Benghazi port and off the coast of the eastern city on Sunday.

title: Heavy fighting in Ituri traps DR Congo Ebola responders: WHO
summary: Heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has disrupted the vital work of Ebola responders and forced emergency teams to take cover for more than 24 hours.

title: Security Council LIVE: Winter attacks on Ukraine's power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies
summary: As winter sets in, the Security Council held a high stakes meeting Monday to discuss how Russian attacks on Ukraine's energy grid are leaving civilians without heat, power and water. It will also look at how strikes on Black Sea shipping threaten grain supplies to import-dependent countries far from the war’s frontline.

title: UN chief urges talks on global AI safety framework, warns of historic shift in power
summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres on Monday called on Member States to begin discussions on a multilateral framework for managing the risks of artificial intelligence (AI), warning that the technology is driving “the biggest transfer of power in the history of humankind”.

title: Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development, UN warns
summary: The UN deputy chief urged renewed international support for a two-State solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict on Monday, warning that Palestinians continue to face violence, displacement and dire living conditions despite the October 2025 ceasefire in Gaza.
